content.title: Chapter 30 - ELECTIONS — Sec. 30-5. - Annexed lands.
content.summary:
Any area annexed to the city in the future shall be automatically considered as a
               part of the council district and voting precinct of which it is a part by extension
               of district and precinct boundaries in a straight line.
(Code 1981, § 11-5; Ord. No. 3511, § 2, 2-1-1999…
